visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Same left panel as REF-05. Right: five objects at larger scale — gilt-framed mountain landscape high centre (wall), writing table centre (hero), bronze urn on pedestal in front of the table, carved lion group front right, black chinoiserie breakfront right (tall, cropped).
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Five extracted objects, each large; the urn stands in front of the table, the lion in front of the cabinet, the painting behind the table. Soft shadows, no plinths.
visual_read.composition_style: Left panel + right stage; fewer, bigger objects than REF-05 with more overlap and clearer depth.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller leads; URL in the green footer band.
visual_read.footer_treatment: Full-width green band with gold URL.
visual_read.photographic_style: Extracted catalogue photography; warm wood and gilt tones.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: Implied floor and wall; painting hangs above the table as it would in a room.

strongest_attributes: Same event, different merchandise selection and scale — the Owner approved both, which shows he values variation within a campaign
Painting hung above furniture: the wall-over-floor logic of 3M.3 Version B
Urn in front of table in front of painting: three clean depth planes with five objects
transferable_lessons: A mid-campaign refresh should change merchandise selection, scale and arrangement, not the brand frame (validates 'standardize the frame, customize the event')
Five objects can fill 60% of a landscape canvas when scale is pushed
Wall art belongs above grounded furniture, not floating beside it
do_not_generalize: Green/gold palette and band; seller faces and flourishes
The specific arrangement (table centre, urn front) is one solution, not a slot template

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: Room-like: painting on the wall plane, table and cabinet on the floor, urn and lion forward.
composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: Table legs, urn pedestal, lion base and cabinet all meet one implied floor.
composition_assessment.depth: Three planes with meaningful overlaps (urn/table, lion/cabinet, table/painting).
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Painting and cabinet as tall anchors; table as the horizontal anchor; urn and lion as mid-scale foreground.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Cabinet exits the right edge; painting frame nearly touches the top.

provenance.analysis_method: Direct visual inspection of the full-resolution image; pixel statistics computed from the file; est_* fields are visual estimates. No filename-based inference.
